subject_name: Software Architecture and Design_Kiến trúc và thiết kế phần mềm

meta.Syllabus Name: Software Architecture and Design_Kiến trúc và thiết kế phần mềm
meta.Time Allocation: Study hour (150h) = 45h contact hours + 145-minute final exam + 102,6h self-study
meta.Description:
This is a course in concepts and methods for the architectural design of software systems of
sufficient size and complexity to require the effort of several people for many months.
Fundamental design concepts and design notations are introduced. Several design methods are
presented and compared, with examples of their use. Students will undertake a term project
working in small groups addressing the design of a relatively complex software system.
meta.StudentTasks:
Students must attend at least 80% of contact slots in order to be accepted to the final examination.
- Student is responsible to do all exercises given by instructor in class or at home and submit on time
- Constantly follow announcements on LMS at https://flm.fpt.edu.vn/ for up-to-date course information regarding assignment submission and feedback on assignments and project work.
meta.Tools:
-Internet
-The Rational Software Architect CASE tool
-Visual Paradigm, MagicDraw, and Visio

chunks.subject_name: Software Architecture and Design_Kiến trúc và thiết kế phần mềm
chunks.text:
Description: This is a course in concepts and methods for the architectural design of software systems of
sufficient size and complexity to require the effort of several people for many months.
Fundamental design concepts and design notations are introduced. Several design methods are
presented and compared, with examples of their use. Students will undertake a term project
working in small groups addressing the design of a relatively complex software system.
NoCredit: 3
Pre-Requisite: SWE201c or SWE202c, PRO192
Time Allocation: Study hour (150h) = 45h contact hours + 145-minute final exam + 102,6h self-study
StudentTasks: Students must attend at least 80% of contact slots in order to be accepted to the final examination.
- Student is responsible to do all exercises given by instructor in class or at home and submit on time
- Constantly follow announcements on LMS at https://flm.fpt.edu.vn/ for up-to-date course information regarding assignment submission and feedback on assignments and project work.
MinAvgMarkToPass: 5
